arguments.title: CARD274 NVIDIA DGX Spark vLLM tool call proof
arguments.content: Nemotron on NVIDIA DGX Spark: vLLM tool call proof-of-concept demonstrating LLM inference on Spark-accelerated hardware. Nemotron model offloaded to DGX Spark GPU, vLLM serving pipeline verified end-to-end.
arguments.summary: Proof-of-concept note verifying Nemotron LLM inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark via vLLM tool call chain.
